thread:
Lina: quick heads-up — pilots asking if MVP includes per-user exports and advanced filters. Sales needs commitment this week.
Tom: exports were pushed to v1 in spec. MVP = core inference + basic analytics.
Sunil: exports = auth + pagination + storage + infra. At least 2 backend sprints + frontend work.
Carla: decision point: delay launch or cut exports. Current ship target: Jun 9.
Emma: sales says pilots prefer it but will accept a temporary workaround (manual CSV) if we give ETA.
Raj: alternative: capture export-ready payloads now and expose later. Low UI work initially.
Tom: we can store export payloads and add an export endpoint later. Saves front-end effort.
Lina: proposed path:
1) Ship MVP on Jun 9: core product + basic analytics + webhook hooks.
2) Defer export UI & advanced filters to v1 (target early Sept).
3) Provide manual CSV dumps to pilots in interim.
Sunil: engineering impact: removes ~2 frontend sprints and 1 infra sprint. Backend storage + schema = 1 sprint.
Carla: create a feature flag for export_ui so we can dark-launch when ready.
Tom: need a clear cutlist for engineering/design.
Lina: cutlist:
```
exports_ui: off
advanced_filters: off
realtime_alerts: basic only
connectors: webhook-only
onboarding_demo: reduced
```
Emma: sales ok if we publish v1 ETA and roadmap card linking pilots.
Carla: I'll create the public v1 roadmap card and set ETA = early Sept (Q3). Link pilots.
Raj: owners:
- manual CSVs: Support (Raj)
- persist export payloads: Sunil/backend
- webhook hooks: Tom/infra
- roadmap & comms: Carla
Lina: quick vote: thumbs up = cut exports to keep Jun 9; thumbs down = delay launch.
Tom: :thumbsup:
Sunil: :thumbsup:
Carla: :thumbsup:
Raj: :thumbsup:
Emma: :thumbsup: (tells pilots)
deploy-bot: feature-flag 'export_ui' created (off) by Lina — /flags
Lina: I'll update launch doc and notify pilots + sales. Friday 11am follow-up sync.
Carla: noted. Any blockers before Friday ping the thread.
Lina: thanks team. End.
